kept.claim: The object literal evaluates every import() when the module loads, so all 28 app packages are still loaded eagerly on first import; the registry should store `() => import(...)` thunks.
kept.evidence: packages/app-store/index.ts:1-31: an object literal evaluates every property value when it is built, so all 28 import() calls start when the module is evaluated. Consumers (getCalendar.ts:15, videoClient.ts:26, the payment call sites) only await promises that already exist. No thunk or memo layer, so the first importer loads every app. The promises have no .catch until a lookup awaits them, so the unhandled-rejection point also holds. The thunk fix is sound and type-compatible.
